_comment: Eval cases for engine/main.py. Deadlines are relative (deadline_offset_days from the run date) so the suite stays reproducible on any day. expect_clarify: 'ask' = a good coach should ask first, 'ready' = enough context to plan immediately, 'either' = defensible both ways. done_items = work the ledger marks complete (used by the no-redundant-work scorer). estimate_ratio = measured actual/estimate pace, sent as estimateRatio. expected_effort_minutes = [min, max] realistic total effort for a typical UNSW student to finish the remaining work to a passing standard (effort_rationale explains it); used by the coverage scorer, never sent to the engine.
